messages:
leo: Heads up: sampleapp rerank failing during onboarding. getting dim errors when batching embeddings.
nina: paste error?
leo: `Error: DimMismatch: expected 1536, got 1024` from rerank service.
tariq: which SDK and helper are you using?
leo: node sdk v1.12.4 using new batching helper `compactShard()` that emits `vectors` short form. python sampleapp still uses `embeddings` full-dim.
tariq: ah — wire format mismatch. we changed node to emit shard-compact wire without server support.
leo: also saw retry flakiness: refresh token retry causes a second send with different padding, which shifts indices for rerank. build-bot shows 2 requests within 1s.
build-bot: :information_source: CI job sdk-node/embed-parity failed on roundtrip tests.
nina: short-term: sampleapp will normalize by expanding shard vectors to model_dim before calling rerank.
tariq: longer-term: revert node helper default and add explicit option `wire_format: "shard" | "full"`. also add batch idempotency header to avoid retry skew.
leo: opened PRs: sdk-node revert -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/501 ; sampleapp normalize shim -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/212
build-bot: :white_check_mark: created hotfix branch release/emb-dim-hotfix
nina: i'll add server-side validation w/ helpful error message and a migration note in the changelog.
leo: thanks — will monitor staging after canary. closing unless more shows up. :thumbsup:
